title: 第一卷 第16章 祖地帝威！
novel_title: 开局自曝系统，家族助我娶妻成仙！
content_zh:
姜无痕带沐凝薇来到姜家主殿前，他吩咐雪姨，先带沐凝薇去偏殿吃点东西，他一个人踏入了主殿。

    主殿内，姜临天等一众家族高层还在帮忙筛选着诸天万界那些天之骄女的信息。

    见姜无痕到来，大长老姜临战立刻迎了上来，上下打量着他，惊喜道：“小无痕，你的修为达到化龙境了？这仙心玉体，果然有点东西啊！”

    “只可惜，你没用老夫为你准备的破天丹，不然……至少得是阴阳境修为！”

    姜临战拍着姜无痕的肩膀，眼神里满是欣慰。

    “老大，你少在这胡扯，就你那破玩意儿，自己留着用吧！”姜临渊走了过来，笑着道，“小无痕血气方刚，龙精虎猛，再找十个道侣都扛得住！”

    “现在用不上，不代表以后用不上。难道你没听过，没有耕坏的地，只有累死的牛？”姜临战将玉瓶塞到姜无痕手里，嘱咐道，“别不好意思，拿着，以备不时之需！”

    姜无痕抵不住他的热情，只能将这瓶破天丹收下。

    “行了，小无痕大清早的过来，想必有正经事！”

    姜临天摆摆手，再次把姜无痕摁在了家主宝座上。

    对此，姜无痕已经坦然接受。

    姜临战搓着手，迫不及待的问道：“小无痕，这次那个叫‘系统’的，是不是又给你什么好东西了？”

    “家主，各位长老，你们最好都坐下听。这次的东西有点狠，我怕你们见了站不稳。”

    姜无痕笑道。

    一听这话，众人不乐意了。

    “笑话，老夫纵横天下数万年，什么场面没见过？”

    “小无痕，你只管拿出来，就算再拿出仙阶功法和极道帝兵，老夫也只会微微一笑，绝对不抽！”

    见几人笃定的模样，姜无痕点了点头。

    随即，他先是从系统空间内，取出了一卷古朴的兽皮，其上流露出的道蕴，即便准帝都心生悸动。

    “小无痕，这个是……”

    姜临战问道。

    “十凶宝术之一，麒麟宝术！”

    一句话，如平地惊雷，在众人耳畔炸响。

    十凶宝术！

    修至大成，可是堪比仙阶神通的存在！

    放在任何一个不朽势力当中，都称得上是压箱底的手段！

    “这承载宝术的兽皮，该不会就是麒麟古皇的遗蜕吧！”

    姜临渊震撼道。

    妖族古皇，那可是堪比人族大帝的恐怖存在！

    抛开麒麟宝术不谈，仅仅是这块兽皮，也是不俗的宝物。

    就在众人震撼时，姜无痕挥手祭出了极道人皇幡！

    刹那间，诡异的金色大幡自殿内浮现，其上铜铃晃动，发出阵阵摄人心魄的声响。

    “万魂幡！”

    “不对，此幡非但不显丝毫邪祟，反而中正大气，似乎有功德加持……”

    “奇怪，这分明只是一件灵兵，老夫却看不透它。”

    “小无痕，这究竟是什么东西？”

    众人疑惑道。

    “此物唤作极道人皇幡，是一件功德秘宝。灵器是它的初始形态，是以诸天大功德祭炼而成，杀生、炼魂不沾因果。”

    “它是可以不断晋升的，而且，没有上限！”
content_en:
Jiang Wuhen brought Mu Ningwei to the main hall of the Jiang family. He told Aunt Xue to take Mu Ningwei to the side hall to eat something while he entered the main hall alone.

    In the main hall, Jiang Lintian and other high-level family officials were still helping to screen the information about the proud girls of all the worlds.

    Seeing Jiang Wuhen's arrival, the Great Elder Jiang Linzhan immediately came up to him, looked him up and down, and said in surprise: "Little Wuhen, your cultivation has reached the Dragon Transformation Realm? This Immortal Heart and Jade Body really does have something!"

    "It's a pity that you didn't use the Heaven-Breaking Pill I prepared for you, otherwise... you must at least be in the Yin-Yang realm!"

    Jiang Linzhan patted Jiang Wuhen on the shoulder, his eyes full of relief.

    "Boss, stop talking nonsense here. Just keep that crap thing of yours for yourself!" Jiang Linyuan came over and said with a smile, "Little Wuhen is so full of energy, so powerful that he can hold up ten more Taoist companions!"

    "If you don't use it now, it doesn't mean you won't use it in the future. Haven't you heard that there is no plowed land, only exhausted cows?" Jiang Linzhan stuffed the jade bottle into Jiang Wuhen's hand and said, "Don't be embarrassed, just hold it in case you need it!"

    Jiang Wuhen couldn't resist his enthusiasm, so he could only accept the bottle of Heaven-Breaking Pill.

    "Okay, Xiao Wuhen came here so early in the morning, he must have something serious to do!"

    Jiang Lintian waved his hand and pressed Jiang Wuhen on the throne of the head of the family again.

    Jiang Wuhen has accepted this calmly.

    Jiang Linzhan rubbed his hands and asked impatiently: "Xiao Wuhen, did the 'system' give you something good this time?"

    "Head of the family, elders, you'd better sit down and listen. What's going on this time is a bit harsh. I'm afraid you won't be able to stand still after seeing it."

    Jiang Wuhen smiled.

    Upon hearing this, everyone was unhappy.

    "It's a joke. I have been in the world for tens of thousands of years, what kind of scenes have I not seen?"

    "Xiao Wuhen, just take it out. Even if you take out the immortal-level skills and the Ji Dao Emperor Weapon, I will only smile slightly, and I will never twitch!"

    Seeing the determined looks of several people, Jiang Wuhen nodded.

    Immediately, he first took out a roll of ancient animal skin from the system space. The Tao Yun revealed on it made even the quasi-emperor's heart palpitate.

    "Xiao Wuhen, this is..."

    Jiang Linzhan asked.

    "One of the ten evil treasures, the Qilin treasure!"

    One sentence, like thunder on the ground, exploded in everyone's ears.

    Ten evil treasures!

    After cultivating to great perfection, one can have magical powers comparable to those of an immortal!

    Among any immortal force, it can be regarded as a means to keep the bottom of the box!

    "Could this animal skin that carries the treasure be the remains of the ancient Qilin Emperor?"

    Jiang Linyuan said in shock.

    The ancient emperor of the demon race is a terrifying existence comparable to the great emperor of the human race!

    Putting aside the Qilin treasure technique, just this piece of animal skin is also a good treasure.

    Just when everyone was shocked, Jiang Wuhen waved his hand and sacrificed the Jidao Human Emperor Banner!

    In an instant, a strange golden banner emerged from the hall, and the copper bell on it swayed, making a breathtaking sound.

    "Ten Thousand Soul Banners!"

    "No, this flag not only does not show the slightest evil spirit, but is upright and seems to be blessed by merit..."

    "It's strange, this is obviously just a spiritual weapon, but I can't see through it."

    "Xiao Wuhen, what on earth is this?"

    Everyone was puzzled.

    "This object is called the Jidao Human Emperor Banner. It is a secret treasure of merit. The spiritual weapon is its initial form. It is made by sacrificing the great merits of the heavens. Killing creatures and refining souls are not affected by cause and effect."

    "It can be continuously promoted, and there is no upper limit!"
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 16 The Imperial Power of the Ancestral Land!
